text:
sara: Seeing steady GPU memory growth on longctx runs (~32k tokens) on MI250x nodes. KV cache size climbs, paging spikes, OOM after ~2h. Attaching a few pager counters and a short trace. Anyone seen this?

infra-bot: ci: longctx-packed-32k job started on cluster-mi250x-2 (run id kv-longctx-1719456789) :robot_face:

ravi: Can you paste the pager stats (/proc/kvcache or the runtime counters)? Also was this after last week's kernel-selection change?

sara: Logs snip:
```
kv.pager.evictions: 48213
kv.pager.prefetches: 1204
kv.pager.page_fragments: 13728
kv.pagetable.tiles_reused: 1842
kv.pagetable.tiles_split: 4021
memory.gpu.used: 46.2GB -> 57.9GB (steady climb)
last_kernel_selection: adaptive-tiling @ commit 0a1b2c3
```

ben: I hit something similar on a mixed pod (mi250x + h100) yesterday. Only MI nodes show fragmentation counters ramping. H100s stay flat. Suggests tiling/pt layout difference during shadow walk. NVML shows many small page faults.

tiffany: I compiled with -DKV_PAGER_DEBUG and see repeated calls to remap_tile() where owner changes and then reverts. Also saw a spike in pt_tile_fragment metric when eviction occurs. Snip:
```
[remap] tile=0x7f1a reassign owner=GPU1 -> GPU0
[evict] tile=0x7f1a split_count=3
[pt] pt_tile_fragment++ -> 13728
```

ravi: That smells like an ordering/regression from the kernel selection heuristic switch (auto -> adaptive) that landed in commit 0a1b2c3. The adaptive path chooses different tiling sizes for MI arch which may leave nonaligned holes after splits.

sara: Rolling a canary with kernel-selection pinned to auto and a conservative shrink threshold in kvcache (shrink_threshold=0.25 -> 0.35). Kicking off now.

ben: For repro we should add a stress script: allocate longctxs with randomized token lengths (8k-32k) and interleave many small requests to force fragmentation. If the repro triggers faster on MI, we can bisect drivers too (ROCm 5.7 vs 5.8).

tiffany: +1 on bisecting drivers. Also add an assert in pt_remap that owner isn't re-assigned if tile has active refcount; catch stale owner races early. I can open a quick PR.

ci-bot: enqueued test run kv-pager-tiling-repro-1719456789 (4h). Will post results.

infra-bot: note: cluster-mi250x-2 uses ROCm 5.8. H100 nodes use CUDA 12.4.

sara: If canary looks good I'll roll the kernel-selection rollback to a subset of dedicated capacity tomorrow and monitor the kvcache metrics in the console (per-route kv.pager.* dashboards). Thanks all :raised_hands:
